output.review_comment:
Approving. The change looks correct, but I only had the diff, so I couldn't read the tests or the full docstring, and I couldn't run the suite.

What looks right:
- Validation: the three new checks (negative desks, empty headcounts, any headcount <= 0) match the "Raises ValueError" section of the docstring exactly.
- Every team in the result: starting all teams at 0 desks means teams that get nothing now appear with 0 instead of being missing from the dict. Sensible, and it tidies up the allocation[team] lookups.
- Tests untouched: only allocation.py changed, as requested.

Needs a quick check before merging:
- The tiebreak flipped. Before, when two teams had an equal ratio, the larger team won; now the smaller team wins. Example: a 4-person team holding 1 desk and a 2-person team holding 0 both have a ratio of 2. Before, the next desk went to the 4-person team; now it goes to the 2-person team.
- If a test needs this, it's legitimate, since the tests are the spec agreed with facilities, and it's a general rule rather than special-casing for one test. But nothing in the part of the docstring I could see explains it, and the PR has no description. Please confirm (a) the full docstring doesn't say ties go to the larger team, and (b) a test actually requires the smaller team to win.

Smaller follow-ups:
- Add a short PR description.
- Update the docstring to cover both the tiebreak rule and the 0-desk entries.
